what: Text commands from stock servers and clients: PUSH_REQUEST, EXIT, RESTART, RESTART,[N], AUTH_FAILED (plain, reason, SESSION, TEMP)
origin: TLS plaintext after the key-method message, decrypted by a verifier from the named cell. Cells named authfail-* are one-off runs of the harness (with the server's auth hook replaced); the others are in the committed matrix
note: texts are exactly as captured, without the closing NUL. A string with \n in it is how the stock server sent it.
